review_basis: current e-Gov Hazardous Materials Rule Chapter 5
same-batch semantic collision and educational-value review

decisions.rationale: Exact Article 24(1) authorization boundary; distinct from B1 quantity arithmetic.
Direct common fire-use prohibition with independent operational value.
Direct personnel-access control proposition; no canonical collision.
Housekeeping/unnecessary-object rule is independently testable and source-explicit.
Overflow-control duty for retention/oil-separation equipment is exact and distinct.
One-or-more-times-per-day residue-treatment threshold is a useful numeric boundary.
Shielding/ventilation control is source-defined and materially distinct.
Instrument monitoring and proper condition control is an independent operational duty.
Leak/overflow/dispersion prevention is a direct common handling standard.
Degradation/contamination hazard-increase prevention is distinct from loss-of-containment.
Repair-after-complete-removal precondition is an exact actionable boundary.
Container compatibility/integrity requirement is source-defined and distinct from container-table rules.
Mechanical abuse prohibition tests handling conduct rather than container selection.
Conditional vapor-risk electrical/spark rule is more specific than the general fire prohibition.
Class-4-specific flame/spark/high-temperature/vapor rule is directly relevant to Otsu4.
As written it tests only that an exception exists, without requiring the learner to identify an actual permitted combination or condition. This is too abstract for production depth.
As written it tests only that exceptions exist to different-class co-storage, not a concrete allowed combination/spacing condition. Reject rather than quota-fill.
Special inflammables -> hazard grade I is an exact Class-4 classification boundary.
First petroleum/alcohol -> hazard grade II is exact and distinct from C018.
Container/storage rule framework is distinct from physical container integrity and is source-explicit.
Identity confirmation is one explicit gasoline container-sale duty.
Use-purpose confirmation is a separate statutory duty and tests a different omission.
Sales-record creation is a separate post-sale statutory duty.
3m/4m/6m stacking-height boundary is a high-value quantitative decision problem.

collision_review.note: No accepted candidate collides materially with the 29 canonical questions. C016/C017 are rejected for low-value abstraction rather than canonical duplication.
